title: Calico private public-eligibility classification sidecar (v1)
description: Closed, optional, private exact-key classification sidecar (04-05-PLAN.md D-16/D-18). Lives at one fixed direct child of an admitted store -- never a subdirectory, never a glob -- and is optional in real mode: its absence binds to an empty runtime_input.public_eligibility_classifications relation rather than failing the build. Every entry maps one exact, unique, nonblank State Charity registration number to exactly one of the three closed classification states. Only an explicit 'eligible' entry may ever reach a public relation; a missing entry, or any entry this schema itself rejects, normalizes downstream in SQL to 'unclassified'. This document performs no fuzzy/name matching and carries no score -- it is a reviewed, versioned classification record only, read structurally by calico_dbt.eligibility and never interpreted analytically outside dbt SQL.

schema_version.description: Closed structural schema version for this sidecar shape.

classification_version.description: The reviewer-assigned version label for this whole classification pass -- carried through unchanged into runtime_input.public_eligibility_classifications for downstream audit; never interpreted or parsed.

classifications.description: Zero or more closed classification entries. Every registration_number must be unique and nonblank within this array (T-04-05A); duplicate or blank keys fail the whole document closed.

registration_number.description: The exact full State Charity registration number this entry classifies -- never a substring, never normalized beyond the value the reviewer supplied.

classification.description: Closed three-value vocabulary (D-18). Only 'eligible' may ever reach a public relation; 'ambiguous_natural_person' and 'unclassified' remain privately auditable but never publish.
